title: Harness normalizer rules
description: One file per target. A rule exists only for a field the A/A baseline showed to be noise, and every rule must say why.

case_set_hash.description: sha256 of the case set the rules were written for; a run with a different case set is refused.

path.description: Dotted path in the encoded observation, `$` for root, `*` matches one segment (a dict key or a list index).

reason.description: The A/A finding or case that motivated this rule. Required: a rule without a reason is a bug being hidden.

tolerance.description: float: absolute tolerance, or relative tolerance when used with the value.

tolerance_seconds.description: timestamp: how far apart the two parsed timestamps may be.

pattern.description: regex_mask: the pattern both sides must fully match.
